precise_primary_conjecture.source: Damron and Hanson, Bigeodesics in first-passage percolation
precise_primary_conjecture.statement: For finite nonnegative iid edge weights with a continuous common distribution on the nearest-neighbor graph Z^2, almost surely no self-avoiding bi-infinite geodesic exists. Every finite segment must minimize against all finite lattice paths.
